blocks.h2: Why Call J. Blanton for Gas Fireplace Service

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: Many Hanover Park homes have factory-built fireplaces, a metal firebox framed into the wall with a metal chimney, instead of a brick fireplace. They're designed for specific log sets and parts, so the model number matters. Look for a label inside the firebox or behind the lower grille. Give us that number when you call, and we'll come with the right parts or tell you what can be safely installed.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Fireplace Work
blocks.body: A service visit is simple. Replacing a failed part depends on the part and the fireplace model, since factory-built units often need specific components. Adding a gas line for an insert depends on the route. We diagnose and quote a flat price.

blocks.h2: Gas Fireplace Questions From Hanover Park Homeowners

items.q: Why won't my pilot stay lit?
items.preview: A dirty pilot or weak thermocouple.
items.answer: Usually a dirty pilot or a weak thermocouple.

items.q: Can you add a gas insert to my wood fireplace?
items.answer: Often. We run the gas line and connect the insert. A chimney specialist handles any liner work.

items.q: Why is there soot on the glass?
items.preview: A dirty or poorly set flame.
items.answer: Usually a dirty burner or logs out of position.

items.q: When should I service my fireplace?
items.answer: Early fall, before the first cold night.

items.q: Can I burn wood in a factory-built fireplace?
items.preview: Only if it's rated for wood.
items.answer: Only if the manufacturer rates it for wood. Many are gas-only. Check the label.

items.q: Why does my fireplace turn off after a few minutes?
items.answer: Often a weak thermocouple or thermopile, or a dirty pilot. We'll test and replace what failed.

items.q: How much does gas fireplace repair cost in Hanover Park?
items.preview: It depends on the part. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what failed and the type of fireplace. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
